answer: The knoll index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 806 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the quill. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the jade queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. Bonded capital sits idle for 5 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
